title: He proves by algebra that Hamlet’s grandson is Shakespeare’s grandfather and that he himself is the ghost of his own father
html_source: Stephen’s theory is that Shakespeare acted the role of the ghost of Hamlet the murdered king, and he extrapolates widely from there. See Chapter 9. Mulligan is taking a dig here.
